```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
source("../scripts/site_layout.R")

v <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d%H%M%OS3", tz = "UTC")
v <- gsub("[^0-9]", "", v)

writeLines(sprintf(
  '<meta name="description" content="Explore Gun Violence Archive youth and child gun violence data by state, age group, and rate." />\n<link rel="stylesheet" href="css/style.css?v=%1$s" />\n<link rel="stylesheet" href="css/dashboard.css?v=%1$s" />\n<script>if (window.self !== window.top || /[?&]embed=1/.test(location.search)) document.documentElement.classList.add("is-embedded");</script>\n%2$s',
  v, analytics_html()
), "_head_dashboard.html")

# dashboard.js is the only script that calls d3.* directly (via sequentialRamp
# in utils.js and the choropleth code) and needs topojson to draw the map.
writeLines(sprintf('<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3@7.9.0/dist/d3.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@observablehq/plot@0.6.16/dist/plot.umd.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/topojson-client@3.1.0/dist/topojson-client.min.js"></script>
<script src="js/utils.js?v=%1$s"></script>
<script src="js/dashboard.js?v=%1$s"></script>', v), "_scripts_dashboard.html")
```

```{r nav, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
cat(nav_html("dashboard"))
```

```{=html}
<header class="site-header page-header">
<div class="wrap">
<h1>Child and Youth Involvement in Gun Violence</h1>
<p class="page-subtitle">Youth and Gun Violence Dashboard</p>
</div>
</header>
<main class="dashboard-section">
<div class="wrap">
<p class="dashboard-lede">Explore trends in any jurisdiction.</p>
<div class="disclosures">
<details class="disclosure">
<summary>How this dashboard works</summary>
<p>This dashboard allows you to switch between counts and rates, choose whether to view raw monthly data or a 12-month rolling average, and explore trends for youth (age 12-17), children (age 0-11), or all children under age 18. This dashboard also allows you to include or exclude incidents that involved only a person under age 18 possessing a firearm. All figures come from Gun Violence Archive. Rates are an annual rate per 100,000 residents in the relevant age group, using CDC SEER single-age population estimates. Rolling averages, where selected, are calculated as a trailing 12-month mean.</p>
</details>
<details class="disclosure data-note">
<summary>A note about the data</summary>
<p>The Gun Violence Archive is a leading source for data about incidents
involving firearms in the U.S. Professional staff at GVA sweep law
enforcement and media sources on a daily basis and record the incident
along with up to 120 different variables in their database. As more
information about an incident becomes available, GVA staff update
incident reports and add additional sources. Incidents in the GVA data
are highly verifiable: 100% of incidents in the child extract have a
source listed, and 56% have multiple sources listed.</p>
<p>Independent assessments of GVA data have found them to closely track
other sources of information about firearm incidents. An evaluation of
GVA data in four cities published in <a
href="https://jamanetwork.com/journals/jamanetworkopen/fullarticle/2805509">JAMA
Network Open</a> found GVA data captured more than 80% of shooting
incidents across six years and that the archive improved over time. By
2020, the GVA database contained 92% of incidents recorded in data
collected by police. Despite the already-small rate of uncaptured
incidents, GVA is significantly more likely to capture an incident that
involves participants under age 18.</p>
<p>The GVA is intended to capture all types of incidents involving
firearms, not merely incidents that involve criminal behavior. It
includes, for instance, incidents involving accidental shootings, gun
possession, and suicide.</p>
<p>Analyses of GVA data yield similar but not identical results to
analyses of other sources of data. Trends and jurisdictional profiles <a
href="https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7587299/">broadly
align</a> with data from the CDC’s Vital Statistics Survey and the FBI’s
National Incident-Based Reporting System (NIBRS). One key cause of
divergences between GVA data and governmental sources is that
governmental sources such as NIBRS use sampling techniques and
extrapolation to account for missing data whereas the GVA contains only
verified incidents.</p>
<p>The analyses presented here exclude incidents that we were able to identify as
consisting only of a single youth possessing a firearm. For more details, see the
<a href="about.html">About page</a>.</p>
<p class="bottom-line"><strong>Bottom line:</strong> No source captures every firearm
incident in the United States, and GVA, police, and hospital data all
diverge to some degree wherever they have been compared. For narrow
analyses — a specific city or short time period — local police or
hospital records may offer more precision. But for tracking national
patterns over time, GVA is the most comprehensive, transparent, and
consistently sourced public option, and one that has grown more reliable
each year.</p>
</details>
</div>
<div class="view-bar">
<div class="view-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Dashboard views">
<button type="button" role="tab" id="tab-map" aria-controls="panel-map" aria-selected="true">Map</button>
<button type="button" role="tab" id="tab-trends" aria-controls="panel-trends" aria-selected="false" tabindex="-1">Trends</button>
<button type="button" role="tab" id="tab-compare" aria-controls="panel-compare" aria-selected="false" tabindex="-1">Compare states</button>
<button type="button" role="tab" id="tab-highlights" aria-controls="panel-highlights" aria-selected="false" tabindex="-1">State highlights</button>
<button type="button" role="tab" id="tab-county-map" aria-controls="panel-county-map" aria-selected="false" tabindex="-1">County map</button>
<button type="button" role="tab" id="tab-county" aria-controls="panel-county" aria-selected="false" tabindex="-1">County spotlight</button>
</div>
<fieldset class="control">
<legend>View</legend>
<div class="seg-options is-pair">
<label><input type="radio" name="metric-type" value="rate" checked /><span>Rate per 100,000</span></label>
<label><input type="radio" name="metric-type" value="count" /><span>Raw counts</span></label>
</div>
</fieldset>
</div>
<section class="dash-block" id="panel-map" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="tab-map">
<div class="filter-panel filter-grid" id="geo-controls">
<div class="control">
<label for="ctl-map-metric">Map metric</label>
<select id="ctl-map-metric">
<option value="youth_victim">Youth (12–17) victimization</option>
<option value="youth_perp_minus_possession">Youth (12–17) offenses</option>
<option value="child_victim">Children (0–11) victimization</option>
</select>
</div>
<fieldset class="control">
<legend>Show as</legend>
<div class="seg-options is-pair">
<label><input type="radio" name="geo-view" value="map" checked /><span>Map</span></label>
<label><input type="radio" name="geo-view" value="list" /><span>Ranked list</span></label>
</div>
</fieldset>
<p class="map-hint">Select a state to see its trend.</p>
</div>
<figure class="chart">
<p class="chart-title" id="geo-title"></p>
<p class="chart-sub" id="geo-sub"></p>
<div id="dash-map"><p class="chart-status">Loading the map…</p></div>
<div id="dash-bar"></div>
<figcaption id="geo-note" hidden></figcaption>
</figure>
</section>
<section class="dash-block" id="panel-trends" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="tab-trends" hidden>
<div id="trends-slot">
<div id="trend-area">
<div class="filter-panel filter-grid">
<div class="control">
<label for="ctl-state">State</label>
<select id="ctl-state"></select>
</div>
<div class="control comparison-control">
<label for="ctl-compare">Compare up to 3 more states</label>
<div class="compare-row">
<select id="ctl-compare"></select>
<ul class="chips" id="compare-chips"></ul>
<button type="button" class="text-button" id="ctl-compare-clear" hidden>Clear comparisons</button>
</div>
<p class="hint">"United States" is listed first in both dropdowns if you want the national trend.</p>
</div>
<button type="button" class="filters-toggle" id="filters-toggle" aria-expanded="false">
<span class="filters-toggle-label">Filters</span>
<span class="filters-summary" id="filters-summary"></span>
</button>
<div class="filter-rule"></div>
<div class="control secondary">
<label for="ctl-population">Age range</label>
<select id="ctl-population">
<option value="youth">Youth (12–17)</option>
<option value="child">Children (0–11)</option>
<option value="">Children and youth (0–17)</option>
</select>
</div>
<div class="control secondary">
<label for="ctl-status">Show</label>
<select id="ctl-status">
<option value="both">Victims and perpetrators</option>
<option value="victim">Victims only</option>
<option value="perp">Perpetrators only</option>
</select>
</div>
<div class="control toggle-control secondary">
<label class="toggle">
<input type="checkbox" id="ctl-smoothing" checked />
<span>12-month rolling average or sum</span>
</label>
</div>
</div>
<figure class="chart">
<p class="chart-title" id="dash-trend-title"></p>
<ul class="legend" id="dash-trend-legend"></ul>
<div id="dash-trend"></div>
<p class="chart-note" id="dash-trend-note" hidden></p>
</figure>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section class="dash-block" id="panel-compare" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="tab-compare" hidden>
<div id="compare-slot"></div>
</section>
<section class="dash-block" id="panel-highlights" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="tab-highlights" hidden>
<div class="filter-panel filter-grid" id="highlights-controls">
<div class="control">
<label for="ctl-hl-state">State</label>
<select id="ctl-hl-state"></select>
</div>
</div>
<div class="hl-section" id="hl-incidents">
<h2 class="hl-heading" id="hl-incidents-heading">1. Most incidents do not involve youth.</h2>
<ul class="hl-stats is-three" id="hl-incident-stats"></ul>
<p class="hl-note" id="hl-incident-note" hidden></p>
</div>
<div class="hl-section">
<h2 class="hl-heading" id="hl-ratio-heading">2. Youth and children are more involved in gun violence as victims than as perpetrators.</h2>
<p class="hl-statement" id="hl-ratio-text"></p>
</div>
<div class="hl-section">
<h2 class="hl-heading">3. Youth gun violence rose during the pandemic but has since receded.</h2>
<figure class="chart">
<p class="chart-title" id="hl-trend-title"></p>
<p class="chart-sub" id="hl-trend-sub"></p>
<ul class="legend" id="hl-trend-legend" hidden></ul>
<div class="hl-plot" id="hl-trend"></div>
<figcaption id="hl-trend-caption">Each point is the sum for that month and the 11 months before it.</figcaption>
</figure>
</div>
<div class="hl-section">
<h2 class="hl-heading">4. Youth involvement in gun violence has changed since the pandemic-era peak.</h2>
<ul class="hl-stats" id="hl-peak"></ul>
<p class="hl-note" id="hl-peak-note"></p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="dash-block" id="panel-county-map" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="tab-county-map" hidden>
<div class="filter-panel filter-grid" id="county-map-controls">
  <div class="control">
    <label for="ctl-cmap-metric">Map metric</label>

    </select>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="county-map-wrap">
  <div class="map-legend"><div id="county-map-legend-scale"></div></div>
  <div class="map-frame" id="county-map-frame">
    <div class="tip" role="status" id="county-map-tip"></div>
  </div>
  <p class="county-map-hint">Click any county to see its full profile.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="dash-block" id="panel-county" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="tab-county" hidden>
<div class="filter-panel filter-grid" id="county-controls">
  <div class="control county-search-control">
    <label for="ctl-county-search">Search counties</label>
    <div class="county-search-wrap">
      <input type="text" id="ctl-county-search" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false" placeholder="e.g. Cook County, Illinois" />
      <ul class="county-suggestions" id="county-suggestions" role="listbox" hidden></ul>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
<div id="county-loading" hidden><p class="chart-status">Loading county data…</p></div>
<div id="county-spotlight" hidden>
  <div class="county-header">
    <h2 class="county-name" id="county-name-heading"></h2>
    <p class="county-period">January 2017 – February 2026 (9+ years)</p>
  </div>
  <div class="county-stats" id="county-stats"></div>
  <figure class="chart">
    <p class="chart-title" id="county-chart-title"></p>
    <ul class="legend" id="county-legend"></ul>
    <div id="county-chart"></div>
    <p class="chart-note" id="county-chart-note" hidden></p>
  </figure>
  <div class="county-compare" id="county-compare"></div>
</div>
<div id="county-empty" hidden>
  <p class="chart-status">No incidents recorded for this county in the Gun Violence Archive during this period.</p>
</div>
</section>
</div>
</main>
```
